accepted.question_text: Suppose a random sequence X=(X_k, k∈Z) is φ-mixing, meaning that φ(n)=sup_j φ(F^j_{-∞},F^∞_{j+n}) tends to 0 as n→∞. Must X also be ρ^*-mixing, where ρ^*(n) is the supremum of the maximal correlation between σ(X_k, k∈S) and σ(X_k, k∈T) over all nonempty disjoint sets S,T⊂Z with dist(S,T)≥n, allowing S and T to be interlaced?
